My dryer Whirlpool Duet GEW9250PW had a burnt smell and stopped working mid cycle.  I took it apart and found the control board had a burnt out resistor.  I promptly ordered a new control board Part # 8546219 Rev C from the reputed auction site and replaced it.  My dryer still would not heat but the drum was turning.  Then I followed the trouble shooting guide stuck inside the kick panel of the dryer.  All you need is a multimeter and sure enough it pointed me to this small thermistor  part 3976615.  I ordered this, replacement took 5 mins and the dryer was back in business.

The display on the front of this Whirlpool gas clothes dryer indicated error E-3.  We found a plastic envelope containing instructions for a repair technician taped to the inside of the dryer cabinet after removing the top panel.  Thee instructions said that E-3 was canceled sed by a faulty thermister.  The thermister was located on the internal ductwork behind the removable kick plate.  The plate is held by just two screws .  The thermister is held on the duct with two screws also.  The wiring is connected to the thermister with push-on connectors.  The job will require a set of hexhead drivers which can be found at Harbor Frieght.
